ops.body: Shipped in capt-hook 8.5.0 (commit ef97959b feat(signals) + 2597fd50 fix(general), tag v8.5.0, PyPI live). transcript_texts no longer short-circuits UPS: the prompt is prepended as its own entry to the standard Signals.window scan (window=0 = prompt-only; window='turn' = whole prior turn; docstring documents raw-event crowd-out). Canonical failure pinned: TestF08UserPromptSubmitGatePasses (option-dump writeup then UPS 'hmm' -> gate passes on the assistant entry; empirically fails if the short-circuit is reverted). Ecosystem audit: exactly two UPS+Signals hooks exist — builtin multi-request nudge (fixed to window=0 with a discriminating inline test; its window=1 was inert pre-change and would have false-fired) and show's wall_of_text (intended beneficiary; its window 6->'turn' switch is landing in the show pack). Regression matrix before(8.4.0)/after: cc-context 391->392, cc-notes 255->256, show 174->175 — zero flips, zero regressions, only delta is the new inline test itself. Codex adversarial refuter: 5 vectors clean, 2 findings (test discrimination, window crowd-out) both addressed pre-release.
